name: GPU-based Hash Table for Ray Guidance
definition: A GPU-based hash table used to store ray guidance information (brick IDs) generated on the GPU and utilized by the CPU IO layer. It acts as a set where keys (brick IDs) are values, indicating presence/need for non-resident bricks.
summary: A lock-free GPU hash table that efficiently communicates missing brick identifiers to the CPU for volume rendering, offering lower memory overhead than multi-render-target approaches.
